generation_rule: Generate the literal product of carrier, identity, least-state, excitation, order, gap, record and extension forms. Decide all 256 forms only by admitted exact order, distinguishability, discrete spectrum, electronic state, electron-count and molecular-support laws.
grammar_boundary: Every positive finite set of distinguishable molecular electronic states at one declared composition and geometry. The least element is structural empty One and each remaining state is one positive successor. Closure is depth-independent because adjoining one distinguishable state forces exactly the next positive position and its comparisons with every retained predecessor.
